review.purpose: Compare native Supertonic speech for existing and sentence-aware grouping on two exact problem excerpts
review.reason: Separate phrase segmentation and native delivery from post-synthesis timing artifacts while keeping German words and preset voices unchanged
review.input: Frozen existing German text and English review context: Bill Ackman 325.000-349.960s and Mind Control 0.160-24.960s. Baseline grouping 20s/280chars/.4s gap; candidate 20s/500chars/.25s gap with sentence boundaries. Smoke first baseline Bill cue; workload both groupings for both excerpts.
review.outputs: New native_grouping_trial/smoke and /full folders: individual raw FLOAT WAV per call plus complete input text/times/voices, duration, peak, timing-decision flags and telemetry. No existing files overwritten.
review.quality_tradeoffs: Only grouping changes; source translation errors remain. M1/M2 presets are not clones. Native randomized generation can differ between calls; this small exploratory trial does not isolate stochastic variability. Timing flags are diagnostics only, not applied audio transforms. No retranslation, fitting, trimming, slowdown, media packaging or local model inference. At most 120 generated seconds per clip and 300 per stage.
review.cost_estimate: Unknown actual cost. One CPU container at a time, 2 CPU and 4 GiB memory, two 600-second stage ceilings (1200 total execution seconds), no retries; build/startup, storage and egress may also be billed. This is not a monetary billing cap.
